description: Places the order for a quote. If it is within the buyer's spending rules, payment is captured into escrow (released to the supplier only after delivery) and status is 'paid'. Otherwise status is 'pending_approval' and approval_url must be shown to the human; you cannot approve it. Calling again with the same quote_id returns the same order. Ship-to defaults to the buyer's saved address.

buyer_reference.description: Your PO or store order number, printed on documents

ship_to.description: Delivery address; omit to use the buyer's default

name: place_order
title: Place an order
